g.text: 带内冷却孔的设计，使刀头钻削时冷却更充分，刀头
寿命更长,切屑更容易排出。
Coolant makes cutting head life much longer
and also high pressure cooling liquid pushes
抛光刀体排屑槽，使切屑更容易排出。
Toolholder flutes polished let chips evacuate
无需从机床取下刀体，可方便快捷地在机床上更换刀头
The cutting head can be changed in the machine tool,
No need to take the toolholder out from the spindle
